name: ddd-flow
description: The DDD modelling loop as skills — the design-time companion to swe-flow. One orchestrator (/ddd-flow:design) reads repo state with a deterministic, config-driven script and DECIDES what to run against the goal rather than following a pipeline; it never models. Eight step skills own one step each and are HIDDEN from context (disable-model-invocation), so the plugin costs one description instead of ten: 1-understand (Business Model Canvas + User Story Map), 2-discover (EventStorming; confirmed vs candidate, hotspots, attendance), 3-decompose (bounded contexts, aggregates, right-sized tactical depth, delta-merge), 4-connect (Domain Message Flow Modelling; typed messages, coupling smells, boundary deltas fed back), 5-strategize (Core Domain Chart; measured complexity x sourced differentiation, build/buy/outsource, investment-mismatch report), 6-organise (Team Topologies; cognitive-load budget, interaction modes, Independent Service Heuristics), 7-define (Bounded Context Canvas v5 + Quality Storming; assumptions, verification metrics, open questions, interface critique), 8-code (Aggregate Design Canvas v1.1; invariants vs corrective policies, throughput, size, code-structure contract), plus /ddd-flow:view (live zero-dependency browser surface, four lenses over one model.json). Episodic by design — greenfield projects and DDD migrations, not everyday delivery. Hands off to swe-flow through docs/domain/; authors drafts, never flips a status.
